tools.name: find_games
tools.description: Find Steam games matching filters, e.g. every game tagged both 'Cozy' and 'Farming Sim', released since 2022, priced $10-25, with at least 100 reviews. Tags are Steam's user tags (case-insensitive); all given tags must match. Returns up to 50 games, sorted by review count unless asked otherwise, plu

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find Steam games and DLC by title (or by Steam ID). Returns up to 5 matches, most-reviewed first.

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Data for up to 50 Steam games by Steam ID. Prices are USD cents (basePrice, minimumPrice; minimumPrice is the lowest price Markan has seen, null if not yet known). Choose fields to keep the answer small; default: steamId, title, type, releaseDate, basePrice, numReviews, reviewScoreDesc, shortDescrip

tools.name: estimate_sales
tools.description: Rough lifetime sales and net revenue (low/medium/high) for up to 50 Steam games, computed exactly like Markan's spreadsheet add-ins: reviews x a release-year multiplier (Boxleiter method), and list price x sales x a factor for refunds, regional pricing, discounts, tax and Steam's cut. Estimates, not
